answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. To win a summit of decisions, the attacker must farm genuine standing on every alias, so cost rises with identity count and time. Tending a pigment, watching a ripple, and naming a tide is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
